video_summary.overall_goal: Navigate through account settings for a secondary account (bruce), then leave the app and return, revealing a UI color/theme bug where the Unified Inbox and app bar become tinted pink/magenta instead of the expected blue theme
video_summary.description: User opens the account drawer, goes to Settings > General settings, inspects the 'bruce' account's General settings (including its Account color, a pink swatch), backs out through multiple screens to the Unified Inbox, presses Home, taps into another app (FTP Server) then returns to the launcher, reopens K-9 Mail, and observes the Unified Inbox app bar is now rendered with a pink/magenta gradient instead of the original blue gradient.

overall_flow: Start at Unified Inbox (normal blue theme)
Open nav drawer, go to Settings
Open General settings, view Accounts list (Ezio, bruce, alfred)
Tap into bruce's Account settings -> General settings
View/toggle Default account and Account color (pink) for bruce
Back out through Account settings, Settings, to Unified Inbox
Press Home, briefly view another app (FTP Server) / recents
Return to home screen, tap K-9 Mail icon to relaunch
Reopen Unified Inbox, tap hamburger menu
BUG: Nav drawer header now renders pink/magenta instead of blue
human_readable_step_summary: User starts on the Unified Inbox screen.
User opens the navigation drawer, showing the Ezio account and other account avatars.
User taps Settings from the drawer.
User taps the 'bruce' account under Accounts to view its settings.
User taps into bruce's General settings.
User inspects bruce's Default account toggle and pink Account color swatch.
User backs out of settings screens back to Unified Inbox.
User presses Home, leaving the app; briefly an FTP Server app screen is visible.
User returns to the home screen and taps the K-9 Mail icon to reopen it.
Unified Inbox reopens looking normal at first.
User opens the nav drawer again, and this time the header is rendered pink/magenta instead of the original blue — the visual bug being reproduced.
